title: Promotions
emptyMessage: Create a discount for some days, for a service or with a coupon.
fixedKind: Kind, value and scope can't change: if you need different ones, create another promotion.

guide.title: Promotions
guide.summary: Discounts that bring clients on slow days

steps.title: Create a discount
steps.text: Tap "New promotion", give it a clear name and choose a percentage (1 to 100 %) or a fixed amount (S/ 1 to S/ 500).

steps.title: Choose when it applies
steps.text: Mark the days of the week and, if you want, from and until which date. With no days marked, it's valid every day.

steps.title: For one service or all
steps.text: You can limit it to one service, like the classic cut, or leave it for all.

steps.title: With a coupon, if you want
steps.text: Turn on "Coupon only" and create codes: the client types one when booking to get the discount.
steps.tip: Share the code on your social media or in the Community.

steps.title: Set limits
steps.text: Total uses and uses per client keep the promotion from running out too soon.

steps.title: Check it and pause anytime
steps.text: Each promotion shows how many redemptions it has and how much was discounted. You can pause and resume it.
steps.tip: Your barbershop covers the discount. The type, value and scope can't be changed later: for others, create another promotion.
